resources.string:
Lo mbhalo ubhalwe bold, ukumemeza okuzethembayo,
Nakuba lokhu kudwetshelwe, ukuhleba, ngokungangabazeki.

Amarose abomvu, akudala, yiqiniso,
Ama-Violets aluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, umbala othambile othandekayo.

Ezinye zincane, njengezimfihlo ngokuncane lapho,
Futhi amanye makhulu, afuna wonke umoya.

Imibala ingachaphaza, isibonisi esigqamile,
Kusuka kokuthi okubomvu okuvuthayo kuye kokuthi okuluhlaza okotshani okuthambile.
